No stickers caught yet.\n\nWhen an iPhone sticker arrives it shows up here. You can also open a file from the menu, or share a picture to LightDecoder from another app.

LightDecoder can pick up stickers from your message notifications and decode them here, so you don\'t have to share each one.\n\nThis needs notification access, which you turn on in Android\'s settings. Notification access lets an app see all your notifications. LightDecoder only uses the ones from Google Messages and Samsung Messages, keeps what it catches on this phone, and sends nothing anywhere.
HEIC stickers and pictures from Messages show up here by themselves. Pictures that Messages can already show are left alone.

If the switch is greyed out

Android blocks this switch for apps installed from a file until you allow it.

1. Tap the greyed-out switch once, so Android shows its warning.
2. Tap "Open app info" below.
3. Tap the ⋮ menu in the top corner and choose "Allow restricted settings".
4. Come back here and tap "Turn on" again.
Delete this sticker from the inbox?
Delete every sticker in the inbox? Stickers you saved to your gallery are kept.
Keep every picture, not only HEIC

LightDecoder opens HEIC stickers and pictures with its own built-in decoder (libheif and libde265), so it does not depend on what the phone supports.

Everything stays on this phone.
